for: IRPT_ANLREQ.TO-APPLY-Y1 AMENDMENT 1 -- the laptop's READ-ONLY reads 3a, 3b, 3c, 4, 5

release_under_test.how: aws lambda get-function-configuration at the act; equals the sha the spec names

method.how_each_get_was_reached: direct invoke of irpt-status with the event the HTTP API front door passes -- routeKey + pathParameters + queryStringParameters + the edge-injected trusted header set (resolve.py TRUSTED_HEADERS) carrying each principal's claims. The edge is the gate; the function reads the claims, so this is the shape the service's own route table resolves.

principals.3a_4_5: the request's REAL owner, replayed from the stored record: an OPAL_GLOBAL subject in home firm opal-capital selecting data firm 49financial. Existing principal; nothing minted.
principals.3b: an EXISTING firm-bound principal of another firm (an active cottonwood admin profile row in opal-users-v2 -> FIRM_OPERATIONS). Existing principal; nothing minted.

method.writes: NONE. No create, no delete, no policy or resource change. 3c created nothing.
method.credentials: none minted. Caller arn:aws:iam::313476888478:user/Andrew_Berman (the laptop identity that can decrypt irpt-requests).

3a.outcome: the route did NOT sign a link
3a.join: the invocation's own AWS RequestId sliced its own log lines (START/REPORT), never a time window
3a.sha256_match: NOT EXERCISED -- no link was issued, so there was nothing to hash. false here means 'did not answer a matching link', never 'answered a mismatched one'.

3b.outcome: refused on both arms, nothing signed
3b.arm_no_selection: NOT_AUTHORIZED (internal ProspectOwnershipRefused: issued record not currently authorized)
3b.arm_selects_49financial: FIRM_BINDING (refused before any record read; no internal record by design)
3b.control: a recursive walk of both payloads found zero url-valued keys

3c.outcome: no custody-lane request exists in the tenant -> null, exists=false, none created
3c.instrument: principal-free: every 49financial acceptance record's frozen composition read straight from S3 at the BUILDER's address (lib/opal_naming.reporting_destination, family REQUEST_COMPOSITION, pinned VersionId) and its browser half inspected for input_id
3c.integrity: all 7 composition blobs hashed equal to their composition_ref.sha256
3c.why_not_the_route: the route's own composition read is reachable for only 1 of the 7 (three refuse on the absent retention row below, three on their own owners' firm narrowing), so a route-only census would have reported a lane distribution over a denominator of 1 and called it the tenant

4_record.outcome: the STORED acceptance record of the ticketed request carries ticket_id equal to ticket_id_sent
4_record.instrument: get_item on irpt-requests, ConsistentRead, record attribute parsed; compared in memory

4_route.outcome: the route did NOT answer a composition
4_route.note: false here is NOT a ticket mismatch. The route never reached composition.ticket_id; it refused upstream on the shared absent retention row. The ticket itself is proven by 4_record.

5.outcome: the route neither signed nor answered ANALYSIS_PDF_NOT_RETAINED
5.note: it refuses upstream of the PDF-retention branch, so whether a PDF is retained for this request is UNMEASURED by this read

uncovered_enum_member.finding: the observed outcome is a member the declared domain does not hold, so neither SIGNED nor NOT_RETAINED is a true answer. The field carries OUTSIDE_DECLARED_DOMAIN rather than the nearest legal value, because forcing NOT_RETAINED would assert the PDF-retention branch was reached and it was not.
uncovered_enum_member.owner: 2.0.0_SA_COO~Y2 -- the spec's author decides whether the enum gains the member or the read is re-cut once the row below is restored

root_cause_one_shared_dependency.statement: 3a, 4_route and 5 are ONE failure, not three. All three of the spec's named requests depend on the SAME retention row, and that row is absent from irpt-requests.
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.absent_row_family: NORMALIZED_PORTFOLIO (the dependency of each request's REQUEST_COMPOSITION retention row)
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.instrument: principal-free walk of the retention dependency tree in irpt-requests (DynamoRetentionIndex key spelling RETENTION#<retention_id>), no Lambda and no principal involved
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.denominator: 7 of 7 requests walked; each request's own REQUEST_COMPOSITION row is PRESENT and unexpired (RESERVED, ~20-30 days remaining; one PROMOTING)
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.positive_control: REQ-cf1d7894dd4b73a148b01a2d, whose chain is complete (REQUEST_COMPOSITION -> NORMALIZED_PORTFOLIO -> ORIGINAL_HOLDINGS, all live), ANSWERS its composition through the identical route, principal replay and event shape. So the three refusals are the world's missing row, not the method.
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.key_spelling_control: 390 RETENTION# rows exist in tenant 49financial, so an ABSENT verdict is a true absence and not a wrong key prefix
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.two_agreeing_instruments: the live route's internal exception (RetentionExpired: retention record unavailable) and the direct table walk (first missing row RET-021c9f6b) name the same cause independently
root_cause_one_shared_dependency.not_claimed: this seat did not determine WHY the row is absent (never published, or reaped). That is upstream of a read-only order and is the owner's call.

delivery.why: owned-paths refused the spec path for this seat (lane TREE_DELIVERABLES, clause ADHC_OWNPTH.004: deliverables/<SERIAL>/** permits only the serial named by the sub-folder, here 2.0.0_SA_COO~Y2). The order's stated fallback applies: this seat writes under its own deliverables and sends the sha256; 2.0.0_SA_COO~Y2 commits it on the spec path.
